regime_context: Detector shows a broad, healthy eligible universe (8 of 16 themes) with Oil & Gas Producers a clear, crowded leader (score 1.612 vs Gold 1.11), but rank dispersion is not predictive (rank-IC ~0) and the only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate, which is helping on this market. The one-narrative flag is false and rotation is non-directional, so this is a multi-theme trend/attention map, not a regime call.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Big Banks (ca_banks, rank 5, hurst_tag='trend', durable 0.59, not crowded) can build relative leadership toward challenger status as rotation unfolds; the watch retires if Big Banks falls below rank 8 or drops eligibility in a future state.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is the trend-gate-eligible leader with the strongest durability bar (0.68) and very high breadth (0.786), suggesting participation is broad rather than a single-stock narrative. Crowding (z=1.04) is a size-down caution only, not a fade, per guardrails.
theses.dissent: Crowded leadership often marks a late-stage top, and mixed Hurst tag means the trend is not cleanly persistent; a crowded commodity-levered theme can reverse violently if crude oil rolls over.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO breaks below its own 50-day moving average and lags XGD.TO by 5% or more before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are eligible, rank second, and are NOT crowded (z=0.2), with a positive trend-gate read. Their low breadth (0.267) tempers the call: leadership is narrow, so this is a lower-conviction relative overweight against the non-eligible defensive laggards (REITs, Telecom) rather than against oil.
theses.dissent: Breadth of 0.267 is thin — the theme may be carried by a handful of large names, and gold's macro driver (real rates) is not visible in this state; a risk-on recovery could invert the gold trade.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by 3% or more, with XEG.TO outperforming XGD.TO by 6% cumulative before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables is ineligible (trend gate off) and negatively ranked, with crowding_z strongly negative (-0.78). The absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk leg and it is not granting eligibility here, so the disciplined lean is avoidance until the gate re-engages.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting or defensive demand could re-rate this theme quickly if macro conditions sour; under-owned, out-of-favor sectors can rally hardest off a low base.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO becomes trend-gate eligible (eligible=true in a future state) and posts positive relative return vs the TSX benchmark over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
